M01.evidence: Second actor can be added to existing work via dedicated work.addParticipant command. participants array properly serialized/deserialized to/from PostgreSQL. Full command implementation verified.

M02.evidence: work.get command enforces participant access: only owner and added participants can retrieve work. Non-participants throw permission_denied. Isolation verified.

M03.evidence: Permission violation returns structured errors: work_not_found (404) for tenant isolation, permission_denied (403) for non-participants. All isolation checks fully enforced.

M05.evidence: Optimistic concurrency control implemented in work.update command. Version mismatch throws concurrent_modification error which maps to 409 CONFLICT. Concurrent write protection verified.

M08.evidence: Zero new primitives created. Only added 3 new commands to existing work-core capability, reused PostgresRepository base class, and migrated atomic-composition to PostgreSQL. 100% primitive reuse maintained.
